answer: The length band is a cap tied to the mechanism class, 161 to 258 characters here, and an answer outside it is rejected as padded or truncated before the whisper identity is graded at all. A farm cannot pad a short template to fit, because the duplicate check runs on the padded text and the atlas band is published for each class. Since the measured length is checked against the declared class, the echo audit records the value and keeps the rejection reason. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
